p: virgin daughter of Babylon: Which has lived in wealth and wantonness and has not yet been overcome by any enemies.
throne: Your government will be taken from you.
grind meal: You will be brought to most vile servitude: for to turn the mill was the office of slaves.
make bare the leg: The things in which she sets her greatest pride, will be made vile, even from the head to the foot.
man: I will use no humanity nor pity toward you.
As for our redeemer: The Israelites will confess that the Lord does this for his Church's sake.
Sit thou silent: For shame, and hide yourself.
mercy: They abused God's judgments, thinking that he punished the Israelites, because he would completely cast them off, and therefore instead of pitying their misery, you increased it.
perfection for the multitude of thy: So that your punishment will be so great, as is possible to be imagined.
wisdom and thy knowledge: You thought that your own wisdom and policy would have saved you.

laboured from thy youth: He derides their vain confidence, who put their trust in anything but in God, condemning also such vain sciences, which serve no use, but to delude the people, and to bring them from depending only on God.
to warm at: They will utterly perish, and no part of them remain.
quarter: They will flee everyone to that place, which he thought by his speculations to be most sure: but that will deceive them.
